definitions.gloss: deferred payment, payment after delivery, pay later
definitions.explanation: A payment arrangement where the buyer pays after receiving goods or services. Common in online shopping and business transactions.

examples.japanese: {後払|あとばら}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後払|あとばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
{後払|あとばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支払|しはら}った→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: The pay-later invoice arrived, so I paid at the convenience store.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in e-commerce and online shopping. {後払|あとばら}い⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (pay-later service) has become popular for online purchases. The opposite is ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧ (advance payment, prepayment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後払|あとばら}い⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: pay-later service
- {後払|あとばら}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to support deferred payment
- {後払|あとばら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}→請求書：04698_seikyuusho⟧: pay-later invoice
- {後払|あとばら}い⟦{決済|けっさい}→決済：05466_kessai⟧: deferred payment settlement
